title: dev.qory.runtime.text
description: One text block or thinking block the runtime printed on its standard output, of the main conversation or of a subagent.

session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

text.description: The block's text, unchanged, cut to its first 65536 bytes of UTF-8 at a character boundary when it is longer, with truncated set. A thinking block may have empty text.

kind.description: text for a reply, thinking for the model's reasoning.

role.description: Who wrote the message the block belongs to, in the runtime's words: assistant, user.

agent_id.description: The subagent the block belongs to; absent for the main conversation.

message_id.description: The runtime's id of the message the block belongs to, when it reports one. Blocks of one message have the same id.

line.description: The number of the line of the session's standard output the record was read from, from 1, counting every line, whether it is a JSON object or not. The session sets it on an event of the output source; an event of a hook has none.

truncated.description: true when the session cut text; absent otherwise.
